blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Bohol Rep. Kristine Tutor on Sunday said the peso’s decline to a record low against the US dollar should not be an excuse for power companies to indiscriminately raise electricity rates. In a statement, Tutor said power distributors “must clearly explain and substantiate any additional charges attributed to peso depreciation,” as she urged the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) to protect consumers from “unjustified increases in electricity bills.” “The ERC should scrutinize these charges and disallow amounts that are unsupported or inconsistent with existing contracts and regulations,” she said.
